name: Gulf / US–Iran war
summary: Iran calls the US reply 'not convincing' on 3 Nov after US strikes near Hormuz on 2 Nov
state: US forces carried out limited strikes on Qeshm Island on 2 Nov after the IRGC fired on a US aircraft, officials said (CNN). On 3 Nov Iran's security official Mohsen Rezaei called the US response to Iran's seven conditions 'not convincing' and said Hormuz would reopen only once they are met (Anadolu). An Indian-crewed dhow was struck in the strait on 3 Nov, killing one seafarer (CBS). Qatari mediators expect feedback within 36 hours.
for_you: Shipping, fuel and travel across the Gulf remain disrupted. Check FCDO travel advice before travelling to the region.
rubric_hit: Active US–Iran strikes and Hormuz substantially closed = Alert

why: Direct hostilities between Iran and the US or Israel threaten Gulf energy infrastructure, the Strait of Hormuz and the wider region.
drivers: Strikes and retaliation, attacks on shipping and Gulf states, mediation and ceasefire talks, US force posture.

rubric.alert: Active strikes between states, attacks on Gulf energy infrastructure or shipping, or the Strait of Hormuz substantially closed.
rubric.watch: A ceasefire or stalemate with sporadic strikes, or credible threats of renewed strikes.
rubric.normal: No direct state-on-state hostilities; diplomacy active.
